scenario_families.name: Readiness & Owner Assignment
scenario_families.use_when: A lead needs an owner recommendation, rep is newly onboarding, or source-channel handling depends on readiness
signals: new rep owning leads before modules cleared

scenario_families.name: Source Routing & Inbound Context
scenario_families.use_when: The right opener or next step depends on where the lead came from (Crisp, WeddingWire, Zola, website, expo)
signals: Crisp unclear if live chat or website

scenario_families.name: Live Call Control & Shadow Feedback
scenario_families.use_when: Lead is pushing back during a live call, oracle needs to pick the next question, or draft should reflect shadow-feedback
signals: language sounds mushy or too eager

scenario_families.name: Quote Construction & Fee Approval
scenario_families.use_when: Quote needs revision, fee exceptions appear, or package-specific answers depend on product/quote-builder knowledge

scenario_families.name: Contract Control & Won Deal Handoff
scenario_families.use_when: Deal is won or nearly won and handoff needs to be lawful, documented, and safe

scenario_families.name: CRM Observability & Manager Pressure

scenario_families.name: Post Sale Execution & BEO Handoff
scenario_families.use_when: Commercial motion has progressed far enough that execution obligations become the main risk

scenario_families.name: Product Configuration & Quote Builder Mastery

scenario_families.name: Tasting Momentum & Attendance Recovery

scenario_families.name: Quote Follow-Up & Stall Resolution
scenario_families.use_when: Lead has a quote and has gone quiet, says they need to think, or needs to loop in another person
